headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 27, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Cade Cavalli earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Los Angeles Angels secured a 10-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Vaughn Grissom leading the charge at the plate.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, including José Berríos, who has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow stress fracture. Alejandro Kirk has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left thumb fracture. Other players on the injured list include Luis Robert Jr. with a lumbar spine disc herniation, Aaron Civale with right shoulder tendinitis, Denzel Clarke with a mid foot bone bruise in his right foot, Noah Schultz with right knee patellar tendinitis, Logan Henderson with a low back strain, and Jesse Scholtens with a right wrist sprain.

The Detroit Tigers have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of LHP Juanmi Vasquez in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The Colorado Rockies have traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations. The Cincinnati Reds have traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Guardians 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Cade Cavalli earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays suffered a 6-1 defeat at the hands of the Baltimore Orioles, with the Orioles' offense outpacing the Rays' in the final score. Samuel Basallo led the Orioles' batting effort with a home run and 3 RBIs, while Shane Baz pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers 10-6**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 10-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Vaughn Grissom leading the charge at the plate. Grissom's impressive performance included 3 hits, 1 home run, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Suffer Worst Loss of Season**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs fell to the Pittsburgh Pirates 12-1, marking their worst loss of the season. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Cubs' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Berríos Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: José Berríos, a right-handed pitcher, has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow stress fracture. The injury occurred on an unspecified date.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
